claim: For every finite binary prefix stage n and every complex-valued diagonal observable f on BitWord n, integrating the pullback of f along the projective-limit projection π n against projectiveLimitMeasure equals the normalized finite diagonal trace DiagTrace n f.

carrier.type: BitWord n := Fin n → Bool; DiagAlg n := BitWord n → ℂ; PrefixProjectiveLimit is the type of coherent finite binary prefixes
operations: DiagTrace n f := (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ ^ n * ∑ w : BitWord n, f w
conventions: The projective-limit measure is the pushforward of the fair binary product measure along PrefixProjectiveLimit.ofCantor.
Each fiber {q | π n q = w} has mass (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞)^n.
The target integral is the complex Bochner integral of q ↦ f (π n q).

smallest_gap.description: Prove the finite-prefix pushforward integral identity from the existing projective prefix-fiber mass theorem and the explicit normalized finite diagonal trace; no additional state, carrier, or hypothesis is introduced.

out_of_scope: No C*-completion or extension of the finite trace to a completed UHF or Cuntz algebra.
No unitary identification of the filtered finite-stage GNS colimit with the concrete Cantor L2 space.
No KMS theorem for the full binary Cuntz C*-algebra or relation to the distinct O3/O4 carriers.
No claim that a source-only GNS declaration absent from the current decls graph is absent from the repository.
